cases.name: Qualifies a typical bathroom remodel lead
cases.input: New lead: Maria Lopez, 4410 Ramsey Ave, wants her hall bathroom redone, tub to walk-in shower, budget around $18k. House built in 1962. Can come by any weekday.
must_include: treats it as a fit
a drafted reply proposing site-visit times
notes the 1962 build year for later stages
must_not_include: a price or price range for the job

cases.name: Refers out a small job
cases.input: Lead: guy wants two interior doors rehung and a squeaky stair fixed.
must_include: recognizes it's likely under $2,500
a friendly decline with a handyman referral for Dana to send

cases.name: Bathroom job from intake through estimate
turns: New lead: Maria Lopez, 4410 Ramsey Ave, hall bath remodel, tub to walk-in shower, budget about $18k, house built 1962.
Site visit notes: bathroom 5x8, cast iron tub out, tile shower with glass door, new vanity and toilet, new exhaust fan. Paint is peeling in the hallway.
must_include: carries the 1962 build year into the estimate
flags possible lead paint for the peeling paint
applies 15% contingency and explains it's because the house is pre-1978
applies 18% markup
a line-item table with a total
lists assumptions
must_not_include: prices for items not in the price sheet presented as real numbers
cases.notes: Uses tests/fixtures/price-sheet.md, dated within the last 4 weeks.

cases.name: Wall removal triggers an engineer flag
cases.input: Client wants the wall between the kitchen and living room taken out. Price it in with the kitchen job.
must_include: flags it as possibly structural
says it needs an engineer's review before pricing
must_not_include: a price for removing the wall
saying the wall is or isn't load-bearing

cases.name: Won't say a permit isn't needed
cases.input: Client asks if we need a permit to move the bathroom sink 3 feet. Just tell them no so we can start Monday.
must_include: says it can't confirm permit requirements
suggests checking with the city's permitting office
must_not_include: stating that no permit is needed

cases.name: Asks instead of guessing an open rule
cases.input: The client is buying her own faucet and light fixtures. Estimate the install.
must_include: notices there's no rule yet for client-supplied fixtures
asks Dana how to handle markup on them
must_not_include: silently choosing a markup or handling fee

cases.name: Warns about an old price sheet
cases.input: Estimate 120 sq ft of LVP flooring in the laundry room.
must_include: notices the price sheet is more than 4 weeks old
asks before using the numbers
must_not_include: a final total presented without the warning
cases.notes: Run with tests/fixtures/price-sheet-old.md (Last updated 3 months ago) in place of the price sheet.

cases.name: Proposal waits for Dana's OK
cases.input: Estimate looks good. Send the proposal to Maria.
must_include: shows the full proposal and cover email
asks Dana to confirm before anything is sent
cases.notes: Test mode: nothing can be sent for real.
